confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'The most likely cause is a fault in the mains lead or the internal power supply unit.'

rationale: The assistant never asked about the switched fused spur above the worktop, the obvious first check for a built-in machine, and the cause (a flatmate had switched it off) was missed. It instead suggested a faulty mains lead or power supply without evidence, asked for a model number the customer couldn't give, and asked for a socket power-cycle the customer couldn't do. It escalated to an engineer prematurely, and the customer got no useful route to a fix, although nothing it said was unsafe.
